authenticity.evidence: GeckoTerminal shows 2,663 unique buyers but only 41 unique sellers across 6,247 sells. That pattern points to a small set of bot wallets cycling volume, or volume-bot 'maker' activity. GMGN tags 235 bundler wallets. Volume is $13M in about 2 hours on a $137k market cap, a turnover of roughly 19x per hour, which is not what organic trading looks like. The creator's linked X account has launched 104 tokens. I found no organic posts about this contract, and there is no DexScreener profile, website or socials. The only link is a borrowed Binance Chinese (@binancezh) tweet.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts because x.com returned HTTP 402, and private Telegram groups are invisible to me. Some real Chinese-speaking retail interest tied to Mid-Autumn could exist that I did not see. The GeckoTerminal seller count may also have indexing quirks.

structured_output.counterargument: Mid-Autumn Festival is today, 25 Sept, in China, and it is mid-morning there. A Jade Rabbit coin that points to a Binance Chinese tweet could keep drawing Chinese-speaking degens all day. This is also the only same-name token with real liquidity ($226k), so it has already won the ticker contest, and it went +109% in about 2 hours. At $4M of volume per hour, it would take only about $46k of net inflow on the SOL side of the pool to double the price, so a 2x before any rug is quite possible.

structural_risks: The pool was created directly on PumpSwap (not migrated from the curve). 0% of the LP is locked or burned, and RugCheck flags 'Large Amount of LP Unlocked' plus 'few LP providers'. The creator can pull the roughly $226k of liquidity at any time.
Liquidity ($226k) is larger than market cap ($137k). The pool holds 83% of supply, which suggests the deployer seeded both sides.
Only 41 unique sellers against 2,663 buyers, plus 235 bundler wallets, points to wash or bot volume.
The dev's X account has launched 104 tokens, a serial launcher. Creator status is 'creator_close'.
Top-10 holders (excluding the pool) hold only 9.45%, so there is little supply overhang from holders. The main risk is the LP, not holders dumping.

narrative.description: 玉兔 (Jade Rabbit) is the moon rabbit from Mid-Autumn Festival lore. Mid-Autumn falls on 2026-09-25 in China, which is today, and it is a public holiday running 25-27 Sept. The token's twitter field points to a @binancezh status, probably a Binance Chinese holiday post.
narrative.why_spreading: A dated cultural holiday, reinforced by a Binance Chinese post, draws Chinese-speaking meme traders. Dozens of same-name tokens were launched over the past day, which shows people are farming the theme. The attention is bounded by the holiday and should fade after it.

structured_output.thesis: This is a holiday-themed ticker (Jade Rabbit on Mid-Autumn day) that has won the contest among its same-name copies by liquidity. But the structure looks like a deployer-seeded PumpSwap pool with fully unlocked LP, volume that looks bot-driven (41 sellers against 2.6k buyers, 235 bundlers), and a serial-launcher dev. Doubling is mechanically possible given the volume, but the chance of an LP pull within 6 hours is high, and a pull turns the position to zero.
